# How to Trim Audio with Codex MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Codex MCP and Medux to cut an audio file to a specified time range, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_trim_audio`

## Prompt

```text
Cut an audio file to a specified time range.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input audio file id.
- `start_time` (optional): e.g. 00:00:05.
- `end_time` (optional): e.g. 00:01:00.
- `duration` (optional): e.g. 00:00:55. At least one of start time/end time/duration required.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: trim-audio-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Codex notes

- Use `/mcp` to confirm that Medux and the expected tools are available.
- Workspace paths must point to the intended local inputs and output directory.
- Review any network, shell, or filesystem approval requested during upload, download, or verification.
